import os
import click

@click.group()
def cli():
    """FastAPI Laravel-style management commands."""
    pass

# ---------------------
# Create Model File
# ---------------------
@cli.command("make:model")
@click.argument("name")
def make_model(name):
    """Create a new SQLAlchemy model file."""
    name = str(name).strip()
    class_name = name.title().replace("_", "")
    file_name = name.lower().replace(" ", "_") + ".py"
    filepath = os.path.join("app", "db", "models", file_name)

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(filepath), exist_ok=True)

    template = f'''"""
Model: {class_name}
"""
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, DateTime, func
from app.core.database import Base

class {class_name}(Base):
    __tablename__ = '{name.lower()}s'  # Pluralized table name

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(255), index=True)

    # Add more columns here

    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, server_default=func.now())
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=True, onupdate=func.now())
'''

    with open(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(template)
    print(f"✅ Model created: {filepath}")


# ---------------------
# Create Controller File
# ---------------------
@cli.command("make:controller")
@click.argument("name")
def make_controller(name):
    """Create a new controller file."""
    name = str(name).strip()
    class_name = name.title().replace("_", "") + "Controller"
    file_name = name.lower().replace(" ", "_") + "_controller.py"
    filepath = os.path.join("app", "api", "controllers", file_name)

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(filepath), exist_ok=True)

    template = f'''"""
Controller: {class_name}
"""
import logging
from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.exc import SQLAlchemyError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class {class_name}:
    def index(self, db: Session):
        try:
            # Logic to list resources
            return []
        
        except HTTPException:
            raise

        except SQLAlchemyError as e:
            logger.exception(f"SQLAlchemyError failed with error: {e}")
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Failed to fetch SQLAlchemyError")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Unexpected error: {e}")
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Internal Server Error")

    def show(self, db: Session, item_id: int):
        try:
            # Logic to show a single resource
            return {{"id": item_id}}
        
        except HTTPException:
            raise

        except SQLAlchemyError as e:
            logger.exception(f"SQLAlchemyError failed with error: {e}")
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Failed to fetch SQLAlchemyError")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Unexpected error: {e}")
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Internal Server Error")

    def store(self, db: Session, data: dict):
        try:
            # Logic to create a new resource
            return {{"message": "Resource created", "data": data}}
        
        except HTTPException:
            raise

        except SQLAlchemyError as e:
            db.rollback()
            logger.exception(f"SQLAlchemyError failed with error: {e}")
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Failed to fetch SQLAlchemyError")
        except Exception as e:
            db.rollback()
            logger.exception(f"Unexpected error: {e}")
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Internal Server Error")
        

    def update(self, db: Session, item_id: int, data: dict):
        try:
            # Logic to update a resource
            return {{"message": f"Resource {{item_id}} updated", "data": data}}
        
        except HTTPException:
            raise

        except SQLAlchemyError as e:
            db.rollback()
            logger.exception(f"SQLAlchemyError failed with error: {e}")
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Failed to fetch SQLAlchemyError")
        except Exception as e:
            db.rollback()
            logger.exception(f"Unexpected error: {e}")
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Internal Server Error")
        

    def destroy(self, db: Session, item_id: int):
        try:
            # Logic to delete a resource
            return {{"message": f"Resource {{item_id}} deleted"}}
        
        except HTTPException:
            raise

        except SQLAlchemyError as e:
            db.rollback()
            logger.exception(f"SQLAlchemyError failed with error: {e}")
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Failed to fetch SQLAlchemyError")
        except Exception as e:
            db.rollback()
            logger.exception(f"Unexpected error: {e}")
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Internal Server Error")
'''

    with open(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(template)
    print(f"✅ Controller created: {filepath}")


# ---------------------
# Create Request (Schema) File
# ---------------------
@cli.command("make:request")
@click.argument("name")
def make_request(name):
    """Create a new Pydantic schema for request validation."""
    name = str(name).strip()
    class_name = name.title().replace("_", "") + "Request"
    file_name = name.lower().replace(" ", "_") + "_request.py"
    filepath = os.path.join("app", "api", "schemas", file_name)

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(filepath), exist_ok=True)

    template = f'''"""
Request Schema: {class_name}
"""

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
from typing import Optional

class {class_name}(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=50)
    description: Optional[str] = None

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)
'''

    with open(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(template)
    print(f"✅ Request schema created: {filepath}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    cli()
